subject: Candidate day-of playbook: virtual stage directions and accessibility coordination
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@example.com>, accessibility-services <access@a11yservices.co>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:14:00Z
Subject: Candidate day-of playbook: virtual stage directions and accessibility coordination

Hi team —

We have Samira Khan's onsite loop today (virtual) at 09:00 PT. Sending the day-of playbook and a short checklist so everyone knows where to be and what to expect. Samira has requested live captions and a 10-minute buffer before the loop for a quick orientation.

Key items (please read):
- Zoom link (primary): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=RedwoodInterview
- Meeting time: 2026-11-22 09:00–11:00 PT (see calendar invite)
- Panel order: 9:00 PM — Intro w/ recruiter (Laura) — 9:10 — Technical design (Marissa) — 10:00 — Behavioral loop (Jordan) — 10:40 — Wrap + next steps
- Accessibility: Samira asked for live captioning and a 10-minute pre-call; accessibility-services (cc'd) will provide captions.
- Attachments: candidate_resume_SamiraK.pdf (resume), panel_brief_v2.docx (run-of-show + debrief rubric).

Immediate asks:
1) Interviewers: join the Zoom 10 minutes early and mute yourself on entry; have the debrief rubric ready (see panel_brief_v2).
2) Laura/Neha: confirm captions vendor has correct display name ("Live Captions - SamiraK") and that the captions feed is visible to the candidate.
3) Jordan: please keep the behavioral loop to 35 mins and reserve 5 mins for notes.

Samira — I included our accommodations partner so they can confirm captioning plan. We look forward to meeting you; please reply if you need any other adjustments.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

Attachments: candidate_resume_SamiraK.pdf, panel_brief_v2.docx

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@example.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: accessibility-services <access@a11yservices.co>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Candidate day-of playbook: virtual stage directions and accessibility coordination

Thanks, Laura — I appreciate the note. A couple quick things: 
- Live captions are essential; could you confirm whether the captions will be burned in the Zoom window or provided as a separate transcript? Burned-in is easier for me.
- The 10-minute buffer at 08:50 PT works great. I may have a brief audio setup issue; would you be able to provide a dial-in fallback?

Thanks for coordinating — looking forward to the loop.

—Samira

Subject: Re: Candidate day-of playbook: virtual stage directions and accessibility coordination

Thanks — quick update from accommodations: accessibility-services confirmed burned-in live captions will be turned on and the captioner will join as a distinct participant named "Live Captions - SamiraK". They will also push an HTML transcript link in chat after each loop. Dial-in fallback: +1 (555) 867-5309 (pin 4242).

Notes for interviewers:
- Please enable "Gallery view" during the behavioral loop to keep the candidate in the center; captions will display at the bottom.
- If you need to share a doc or screen, prefer the "Share window" option to keep captions visible.
- Debrief rubric: use the score column to keep comments concise — we'll consolidate in the doc after the loop.

I've attached a small update to the panel brief (minor timing tweaks).

Neha Kapoor
Technical Recruiter (Hiring Coordinator)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: panel_brief_v2.docx

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-22T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Candidate day-of playbook: virtual stage directions and accessibility coordination

Thanks all for the quick turn. A couple of last-minute coordination items from my side before we close the loop: 

- Behavioral loop plan (35 mins): 5 min intro, 20 min scenario + probing, 10 min follow-up + candidate questions. I'll use the debrief rubric to score fit and communication.
- Please call out anything you observe about clarity of explanations or tradeoff reasoning — those map to our leveling guide.
- After the loop, post your raw score/comments in the Google doc (link above) within 90 minutes so we can make a timely decision.

Samira — looking forward to meeting you. If you hit any audio trouble, use the fallback number (Neha sent it).

Jordan Blake
Staff Engineer (Hiring Panel Lead)
Redwood Inference
